row.notes: Clears bit 0x10 at self+0x11b and self+0xb0, then handles up to self+0x98 items of the list self+0x130..+0x138 starting at cursor self+0xa8: each item id (vt+0x10) is looked up in the hash map at self+0x1d0 and the item is removed (0x144243680(item,1,1) plus Vm_Screen_LogOnScreenDeactivated, clearing self+0x108/+0x110 if they point at it) when bit 8 of +0x11b is set or its map state at +0xc is 1 or 3. If items remain it sets bits 4 and 0x10 and advances the cursor; otherwise it empties the vectors at +0x130, +0x150, +0x170, resets the hash set at +0x1a8 (and the map at +0x1f0 when bit 8), zeroes the cursor, calls 0x14383e440 and raises node event 0x146105588 (bit 8) or 0x146105590 unless no_event. Callers: the node event handler 0x143832480 and the two teardown paths 0x143832ab0/0x143832b70 set bit 8 first (full clear, the latter two with no_event=1); the tick 0x14383b950 calls it again while bit 4 is set to continue the batch.
